high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in front of an elevator mirror. The individual is standing on a patterned carpet with wavy blue and yellow lines. They are wearing a black jacket over a purple sports bra and matching leggings. Their footwear consists of white sneakers with some purple accents. The person is holding a smartphone with a light-colored case in their left hand and giving a thumbs-up gesture with their right hand. The background features a modern elevator with metallic walls and a control panel on the right side.
